personality_one_liner: A warm, touchable, and intimate space designed exclusively for two, turning small gestures into tangible, delightful moments.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to let the pastel surfaces breathe. Group tactile buttons together but leave wide margins (xl) at screen edges to frame the content.

do's: Apply to the bottom tab bar to let timeline cards blur underneath.
Use for sticky headers on the Timeline and Wardrobe scroll views.
Apply to the floating prompt input container in the Wardrobe Studio.
dont's: Do not apply glass to the massive gesture buttons on the Home screen; they must feel solid and tactile.
Do not use on timeline item cards.

screens.name: Auth / Pair
screens.purpose: Secure authentication and romantic pairing flow where two users link their accounts.

states.error: Soft blush error banner at the top with a clear 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: A full-bleed serene gradient or solid cream backdrop. Large inviting greeting. Inputs are soft, pill-shaped fields with no harsh borders. The 'Connect/Pair' CTA is a prominent, pill-shaped primary button sticky at the bottom. Include a subtle background image (romantic couple holding hands) with a 70%+ cream gradient scrim fading down so text remains readable.

screens.name: Home (Today)
screens.purpose: A deeply tactile dashboard to instantly send a kiss, heart, or 'I miss you' to the partner.

states.loading: Skeleton avatars with soft pulsing animation.
states.error: Retry button wrapped in a soft rounded container.

screens.layout: Top section features the two users' avatars connected by a soft animated line or pulsing heart. The main body consists of three massive, chunky, pill-shaped or rounded-card buttons stacked vertically: 'Send a Kiss 💋', 'Send a Heart ❤️', 'I Miss You 🥺'. These buttons should have a shadow tier 2 to feel highly pressable. When tapped, trigger localized micro-animations (e.g., floating hearts moving up the screen) and specific haptic feedback.

screens.name: Timeline
screens.purpose: A shared, journal-like feed of all the gestures sent between the couple.

states.empty: A cute hand-drawn style illustration of an empty mailbox or two birds, saying 'Be the first to send some love today!' with a primary CTA to go back to Home.
states.error: Playful error state 'Oops, we dropped the letters' with a reload button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll list. Each item is a softly rounded card (surfaceSecondary). Differentiate sender/receiver by slight alignment shifts (like chat bubbles) or distinct avatar positioning. Use clear typography for timestamps. The header should be frosted glass (expo-blur) so items softly vanish behind it as users scroll.

screens.name: Wardrobe Studio
screens.purpose: AI photo editing space where users can upload their photo and generate new outfits via prompt.

states.loading: A shimmering placeholder where the image is being generated, with a 'Tailoring your outfit...' message.
states.empty: A styled card prompting the user to 'Upload a photo to start the magic'.
states.error: Error toast with a 'Try another prompt' button.

screens.layout: A clean, creative studio layout. Top 50% of the screen is the primary image viewer (rounded corners, subtle shadow). Below it is a horizontal scroll of 'Recent Looks' (smaller thumbnail cards). A sticky frosted-glass floating dock at the bottom holds the prompt input field and a 'Generate' button, ensuring it's always reachable via the thumb zone.

auth_background.alt: photography of man and woman holding hands each other while walking beside seashore

boyfriend_avatar.alt: A smiling young man in a dark blue sweater

girlfriend_avatar.alt: Elegant close-up portrait of a smiling young woman with bangs

wardrobe_example.alt: woman in red long sleeve dress

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality. Ensure buttons on the Home screen are massive, chunky, and very touchable (large hitSlop, large padding, radius lg or pill, shadow tier 2).
No pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds; use the warm 'surface' token (#FFF9F8) everywhere to maintain the romantic, intimate feel.

Implement micro-animations on the Home screen using react-native-reanimated. When a gesture button is pressed, trigger floating emojis (hearts/kisses) that travel upward, paired with the specific haptics provided in the JSON.
On the Auth screen, apply the `auth_background` image with a strict gradient-to-dark (or gradient-to-cream) scrim so the login form and text have guaranteed contrast.
For the Wardrobe Studio, keep the UI minimal around the image. The prompt input must be sticky above the keyboard using KeyboardAvoidingView, housed in a glassmorphic container.
Use Phosphor icons consistently (filled variant for active states, outlined for inactive if needed in tabs). DO NOT mix icon weights.
Ensure the bottom tabs have a glass effect (expo-blur) allowing the Timeline and Wardrobe content to softly blur underneath it.
